purpose: Walks the whole first-run journey under a fresh macOS user, from the download to the first reply from the Squire, as one path. Takes the target host as a parameter.
title: Fresh Mac: installer to first reply

testCases.description: setting Squire up from the download on a fresh Mac user opens no Terminal window: every new window belongs to set-up, the browser, System Settings, Apple's tools dialog or the Claude app
